description: Built the old-fashioned way with premium solid hardwoods, the Bloomington Convertible Crib delivers classic warmth and everyday practicality. It transforms effortlessly from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed so your child’s sleep space evolves without ever losing that cozy, familiar feel. Safe, sturdy, and finished in the wood tone you love, it’s the kind of furniture that turns a nursery into a room your family will remember.
